note: Maps each distinct `Park Name` in the WordPress comment export (Google Sheet `RP Comments`, 150DeCFPU3RNlfJ2I0RkWNvqlRCLaVvoZVaEPHX5lNXE, read 2026-09-21) onto a content file. This file, not docs/park-name-changes.json, is the join key for the archive import: two archive names (`Pappas Park`, `Badgerow Park North`) match neither that file's `old` column nor its `new` column. `kind` is `park` for a park page, `page` for a non-park page, and `attachment` for a WordPress media page whose title is the image title; comments on an attachment page belong on the parent park page. Pingbacks (empty email, a URL in the author cell) are counted here and dropped by the import. Wayfinder ticket #26.

Five pages carry or carried this title. Henrietta, Penfield and Webster match the current title, but none has WordPress-era photos in static/ and all three read as new pages. park-name-changes.json records that both Greece and Rush were titled 'Veterans Memorial Park' on WordPress, so the export collapses two old posts into one name and has no post id to split them. The two pingbacks are Rush (one is from the Rush Stoney Brook Road Park page, the other names Honeoye Creek Falls) and drop anyway. The one real comment, 2014-10-10, asks about renting 'this pavilion' for a wedding; neither the Greece nor the Rush page mentions a pavilion, so it cannot be placed.
